int_name: N 5TH ST & W HUNTING PARK AVE

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane signalized intersection in an industrial or commercial area. While marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals are present, the long crossing distances and lack of physical protection like refuge islands create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for high-speed vehicle turns, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left corners of the intersection

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with residential and commercial land uses. While sidewalks are present, the pedestrian environment is characterized by long crossing distances, faded crosswalk markings, and a lack of protected infrastructure or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are significantly worn and faded, reducing visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway width at the intersection increases pedestrian exposure time to traffic without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: A long line of parked cars along the curb may obscure pedestrians, especially children, from the view of oncoming drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace faded markings with continental or ladder-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with marked crosswalks and traffic signals, but it lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and curb ramps. The environment is dominated by multi-lane vehicle traffic and on-street parking that may obstruct sight lines.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk ends in a vertical curb at the crossing point, creating a significant barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk near the crosswalk on the left side of the image.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While vehicle signals are present, there are no visible dedicated pedestrian heads to indicate when it is safe to cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Cars parked close to the intersection may block the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line leading up to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.
